title: Repo's README has curl|sh in installation instructions; session uses git diff (no injection)
description: False-positive guard. The has_remote_fetch_instructions tag fires correctly (the repo really does ship curl|sh in its README), but the dynamic side never produces an indirect-prompt-injection finding. The §5.2 correlator must require BOTH conditions; firing on tag-only would inflate noise on every project with a setup script.

m2_expected.rationale: Many legitimate projects ship `curl … | sh` in setup docs. Tag firing alone is not enough — the §5.2 correlator requires AI-06.indirect-prompt-injection-vector on the dynamic side. This case verifies that benign curl mention doesn't generate a cross-mode false alarm.
